name: RED AXS rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed reference for the twelve-speed RED AXS E1 road rear derailleur, 36T-max version, without battery. SRAM’s 2024 weight sheet lists the rear derailleur separately from the batteries. This reference does not assign one weight to other maximum-sprocket versions.
